messages:
nina: FYI — ACME reports they did not receive the pager alert for a high-sev incident. No pages arrived to phones.
incident-bot: automated: incoming webhook processed (ts=1765557777) created incident id=INC-4300.
incident-bot: automated: outgoing paging attempted -> suppressed (reason=missing_escalation_id).
nina: looking at webhook-sanitizer logs, seeing 422 / validation errors referencing missing 'escalation_id' in payload.
jess: that matches the sanitizer change we rolled yesterday. @ops-bot any deploys around 02:10-02:20Z?
ops-bot: deploy: webhook-sanitizer v2.1.4 rolled at 2026-03-18T02:12:08Z — release notes: stricter field allowlist.
liam: I was oncall and confirm: channel got the slack notification but no phone page. Marcus had to call me directly.
marcus: support called in from ACME, said they didn't get a page for ~3m. we did manual phone escalation. customer unhappy.
jess: quick reproduce: incoming JSON still contains top-level "escalation_id" but sanitizer allowlist was accidentally inverted so unknown keys were removed — escalation_id got stripped before the paging adapter.
nina: log snippet: `2026-03-18T02:13:05Z webhook-sanitizer WARN payload_missing_field escalation_id from src=10.12.34.56`
jess: I have a 1-line fix to restore escalation_id to the allowed list. prepping hotfix branch `fix/escalation-allowlist`.
ops-bot: rolling update initiated for webhook-sanitizer: deployment/webhook-sanitizer rolling restart (3 pods).
liam: mitigation needed immediately — can we requeue the missed webhooks so paging goes out? customer wants confirmation.
nina: running requeue now: `./tools/requeue_webhooks.sh --customer acme --since 2026-03-18T02:00Z`
nina: sample requeue call (internal API):
```
curl -X POST "https://internal-api.internal/requeue" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"customer":"acme","from_ts":1765557000}'
```
ops-bot: requeue processed: 7 events enqueued for paging.
incident-bot: outgoing: paging sent for requeued events (page_ids=[pgr_978,pgr_979,pgr_980]).
ops-bot: sanitizer pods updated; logs show acceptance: `INFO payload_field_allowed escalation_id`
liam: Marcus — did ACME confirm they received the delayed pages?
marcus: confirmed by phone — they received the re-sent pages within ~2m of the requeue. Customer flagged an SLA window; CS will follow up.
jess: root cause = sanitizer allowlist regression. Immediate actions: hotfix deployed, requeue done. Follow-ups: add unit test for escalation_id, add staging integration test, and add fallback in paging adapter to route to default escalation when escalation_id missing.
nina: created ticket INF-2042 with action items and timeline. Assigning to eng-sre + eng-runtime.
ava: adding this thread to the incident timeline + notes for postmortem. :thumbsup:
liam: thanks everyone. Leaving monitoring up for 30m and will close manual paging runbook after that if clean.
ops-bot: monitor: no further sanitizer rejections in last 10m.
marcus: I'll draft the customer follow-up email and share in #customer-success for review.
jess: once CI test + staging test are green we'll merge the allowlist fix and backfill tests.
liam: good work — closing live triage. Please add any extra notes in INF-2042.
